A new task is stored with a unique ID, a Title (mandatory), a Description, a Status, a Priority, a Creation Date, a Due Date, a Last Updated Date and a Completion Date that is populated only when the task is completed. The system rejects a task with an empty title or a Due Date earlier than its Creation Date.
